about_the_game:
Uncover the truth. Defy YOUR destiny. Escape, if YOU can.

You dream of a world that shouldn't exist, and yet it does; an infinite web of forgotten rooms, long halls, and hostile enemies. Armed with nothing but a cursed artifact, The Atlas of The Deep, you must navigate this shifting nightmare. 

The Labyrinth Of Sublime Terror Saga, or The LOST Saga, is a realistic, ambitious RPG Backrooms title that blends psychological horror, factions, exploration across many of your favorite Backrooms Levels. Every decision you make pushes you closer to uncovering the true purpose of The Deep, or being destroyed by them. This game is NOT a walking or puzzle simulator.

Features:

  • Explore The Deep

    • This game features a main storyline and 17 alternative endings (in Act 1). Journey through both iconic and all-original handcrafted Backrooms Levels, each with unique dangers, resources, and mysterious properties; no two levels are the same.

  • Join or Defy Factions - Play by YOUR Own Rules

    • Align yourself with The Major Explorer Group (The MEG), or resist their influence and join other factions. Every choice you make matters.

  • The Atlas of The Deep

    • A living book that records your discoveries, hints at the truth, and tempts you with knowledge. Beware- it may not tell the whole story.

  • A Living Ecosystem on Each Level

    • Entities don't just chase you, they hunt you. Face off against terrifying entities like Howlers, Partygoers, and Skin-Stealers. Some openly stalk you, and others wear the face of those you trust.

      • There's no cheap jumpscares. Fear in The Deep doesn't come from death, but instead from what might kill you.

  • Travel Alone, or With NPCs

    • When you join factions, you can have NPCs join you on your quest. Co-operation may save your life... or doom it.

  • A Unique Storyline, Told in Acts and Chapters

    • Experience The LOST Saga across multiple Acts. Each chapter deepens the mystery, introduces new allies or factions, and leads towards a climactic end. 

  • Other Info

    • All dialogue in the game is voice acted to maximize immersion.

    • Created mostly by one person, with some help from a few friends.

The Saga Begins Soon...

  • Chapter 0: Echoes of The Deep and Chapter 1: LOST Forever introduce you to The Deep. A reactor meltdown leaves you with two choices: fall into The Deep, or die on the spot. 

The question is not how YOU will survive. Instead, it's what YOU will become.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: N/a
  • VR Support: N/a

short_description: The LOST Saga is a horror RPG set in The Backrooms. Explore "endless" existing and all-new liminal Backrooms Levels, face off against relentless entities, and carve your path alongside factions, or all on your own. The Atlas of The Deep remembers everything, but will YOU?
